title: Registry gate accepted executable URLs passed to browser navigation methods

reproduction.mutableAndComputedReferences: let navigation = window.location; navigation.assign(destination); window['location'].assign(destination); window.location['replace'](destination);
reproduction.beforeFix: The source-isolation check returned pass for location navigation calls, const and mutable aliases of window.location, computed location/method properties, and assignment to the bare global location identifier.
reproduction.afterFix: Calls to location.assign() and location.replace(), statically resolved const or mutable location aliases, computed browser location/method properties, and browser location assignments with executable or active-document URLs fail the source-isolation check.

rootCause: The AST source scanner inspected URL-valued JSX attributes and some DOM assignments but did not inspect navigation calls on browser location objects.
remediation: Recognize browser location objects on window, document, globalThis, self, parent, top and the global location identifier. Inspect assign() and replace() arguments using the existing static-string resolver and apply the executable-scheme checks without executing submitted source.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "browser navigation methods"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: executable URLs passed to assign() and replace() returned pass
validation.aliasAndAssignmentRedBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "bare and aliased location references"
validation.aliasAndAssignmentRedBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: executable navigation through a const location alias and bare global assignment returned pass
validation.mutableAndComputedRedBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "mutable and computed location references"
validation.mutableAndComputedRedBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: mutable aliases and computed location/method properties returned pass
